picks.headline: Apriel Voice 27B Released as Open Speech-Reasoning Model
picks.why: Built on Gemma 4 26B-A4B, it unifies direct speech processing, multimodal reasoning, and tool use in a single open architecture.
picks.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use

picks.headline: Malicious Claude Code Extension on Cursor Marketplace Deploys Backdoor
picks.why: Attackers weaponized a fake extension to establish persistent reverse SSH access, demonstrating active supply-chain risk in AI coding ecosystems.
picks.title: Inside a malicious Claude Code-branded extension and its persistent SSH backdoor

picks.headline: OpenAI Launches Grid Protectors Program to Secure Campus Energy
picks.why: OpenAI is partnering directly with electric utilities to manage grid reliability and energy costs for future massive compute sites.
picks.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program

picks.headline: Cross-LLM Context Transfer Converts KV Caches to Skip Prefill
picks.why: ACCT converts a source LLM's KV cache into a state consumable by a target LLM, enabling zero-prefill context handoffs across models.
picks.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer

picks.headline: Simple Features Outperform 20 of 24 Open-Weight AI Monitors
picks.why: Evaluation shortcuts and author style artifacts mask severe flaws in most open-weight AI control monitors, which are beaten by trivial heuristics.
picks.title: Simple Features Beat Most AI Control Monitors

picks.headline: MCP Tool-Call Metadata Exposes Behavioral User Side Channels
picks.why: Protocol-compliant Model Context Protocol trace metadata allows attackers to reconstruct detailed user profiles without reading message content.
picks.title: How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces

papers.headline: Post-Pretraining Layer Looping Fails to Scale Beyond Small Models
papers.why: Experiments show post-pretraining inference looping only improves performance at 0.8B scale, failing to beat baseline compute efficiency at 4B and 9B.
papers.title: There Is No Free Loop: When Does Looping a Trained Model Pay for Its Inference Compute?

papers.headline: Dynamical Memory Transformer Achieves Constant-Cost Attention Without KV-Cache Growth
papers.why: By decoupling sequence encoding into parallel dynamical memory units, DMT eliminates linear KV-cache memory growth during inference.
papers.title: Dynamical Memory Transformer: Selective Recurrent Memories with Constant Cost Attention

papers.headline: Discrepancy-Lag Correction Fixes Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM RL
papers.why: Identifies numerical discrepancy and policy lag as core causes of RL instability in LLMs and introduces a correction mechanism to stabilize post-training.
papers.title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
